item.title: CVjuvenate Makes Your Career Look Twenty Years Younger
item.description:
Are you an experienced office worker?

Have you spent twenty years developing expertise, solving problems, delivering projects and learning how organisations actually function?

Do you remember when employers valued experience?

Well, congratulations.

You’re now a liability.

Introducing CVjuvenate™, the revolutionary CV anti-ageing treatment that smooths away the visible signs of a long and productive career.

Because employers want experience.

Just not that much experience.

Turn back the career clock

CVjuvenate uses advanced AI-powered cosmetic résumé technology to identify and treat the seven visible signs of professional ageing.

item.title: ASNP Applies For Every Job So You Don’t Have To
item.description:
Do you find that the job market is motherfucking, cunting, twatting, bitching, whoring shit-fucked?

Did you assume that if employment became this degrading, opaque, repetitive and irrational, it must at least be because jobs were no longer necessary?

Did you imagine we had finally automated enough of civilisation that people could become artists, philosophers, amateur historians, full-time hedonists, coastal drifters, or whatever else human beings might do if they weren’t still beholden to the necessity of selling their waking hours to survive?

item.title: BlokeShield VPN
item.description:
The Daily Thrum is proudly sponsored by BlokeShield VPN, the only virtual private network built for ordinary people who are tired of being tracked, profiled, categorised, nudged, scored, sorted, monitored, monetised, risk-assessed and then told the experience is “personalised”.

Are you concerned that every website you visit is quietly handing your data to a coalition of advertisers, analytics providers, platform partners, behavioural insight firms, data brokers, government-adjacent safety initiatives and some bloke in the Smolensk Oblast who knows you looked up “best Punisher” at 1:43am?

item.title: NeverOff: Never Be Alone With An Unmonetised Thought Again
item.description:
Your institutions are failing you.

Your country is being transformed.

You’ll never own a house.

Your wages are being suppressed by forces that somehow remain “complex” whenever accountability is mentioned.

Crime has come to your suburb, but the people paid to notice it have agreed the real danger is noticing it incorrectly.

The 9 to 5 was designed to repress you just enough to drain your will, but not enough to stop you coming in tomorrow.

item.title: SponsorBuster Lets You Skip The Part Where A Man Pretending To Investigate Something Sells You A VPN
item.description:
Do you mostly listen to YouTube in the background now, because Spotify increased its subscription fee?

Are you tired of hearing a man spend forty-seven minutes explaining how society is collapsing, only to pause halfway through and tell you that the real threat to civilisation is browsing the internet without military-grade encryption while buying socks?

Have you ever found yourself washing dishes while some bloke with a ring light says, “And that’s why I started using…” before your whole body tightens with the terrible knowledge that you are about to be sold a VPN, a meal kit, a learning platform, a deodorant, a productivity app, or an online therapy platform by someone whose main qualification is owning a microphone?
